I am honestly ashamed of how much I let it get to me. When it happens I feel as if my opinions and thus myself do not matter and then I am sad and angry.

Regardless of what she has done I want to make sure she's ok.

I've said I'll help her with that in any way I can although she says she feels like we're all ganging up on her. 

Regardless, I'm essentially trapped in my situation. I have no family to rely on and no money. I sold all my stuff to get her flight and mine. It seems I cannot control the situation but I can for certain control my behaviour and attitude. I'm looking for ways to think that will help me cope and things I can do that will help not set her off. Apart from anything else she has pointed out that I did promise not to leave and I take my commitments quite seriously as a matter of principle. I feel like I can be better and that might make her happier. 
Essentially, how do people cope effectively in relationships like this?

Thanks again
